name: smwmusic-thunder-force-iv-sand-hell
title: Thunder Force IV - Sand Hell
description:
This is the very funky, but also very epic, song that plays in the fourth stage of Thunder Force IV. As the title suggests, this stage is supposed to be a desert level, so you could use it in one if the level is fast-paced enough. It could also be used in other settings tho, like a sky level and athletic levels in general.

EDIT: Due to ARAM limitations, I had to remove some of the echo and samples, but luckily I managed to do it in a way that wouldn't detract too much from the original port.

Warning: Not compatible with levels utilizing thunder or blarggs.
